import re

def parse(lines):
    frame_re = re.compile(r'^\s+File "(?P<file>[^"]*)", line (?P<line>\d+)(?:, in (?P<func>.*))?$')
    exc_re = re.compile(r'^(?P<exc>[A-Za-z_][\w.]*)(?::\s?(?P<msg>.*))?$')
    caret_re = re.compile(r'^\s*[\^~]+\s*$')
    chain_re = re.compile(r'^(The above exception was|During handling of the above exception)')
    frames, flines = [], []
    excs, elines = [], []
    skip = []
    tb = 0
    chain = ''
    last = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        if l.startswith('Traceback'):
            tb += 1
            skip.append(i)
            last = None
            continue
        if chain_re.match(l):
            chain = l.strip().rstrip(':')
            elines.append(i)
            continue
        if caret_re.match(l):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = frame_re.match(l)
        if m:
            last = {'traceback': tb, 'File': m.group('file'), 'line': int(m.group('line')), 'in': m.group('func') or '', 'code': ''}
            frames.append(last)
            flines.append(i)
            continue
        if l.startswith(' ') and last is not None and not last['code']:
            last['code'] = l.strip()
            flines.append(i)
            continue
        m = exc_re.match(l)
        if m:
            excs.append({'traceback': tb, 'exception': m.group('exc'), 'message': m.group('msg') or '', 'chain': chain})
            elines.append(i)
            chain = ''
            last = None
            continue
    blocks = []
    if frames:
        blocks.append({'name': 'frames', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': flines, 'records': frames})
    if excs:
        blocks.append({'name': 'exceptions', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': elines, 'records': excs})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
